chips.label: romeo_juliet penguins Paris pancake socks spoon wobbly dance 7 elbow giggle
chips.stdout:
Two penguins, both alike in dignity,
In fair Paris, where we lay our scene,
From ancient pancake break to new mutiny,
Where civil blood makes civil hands unclean.
From forth the fatal loins of these two foes
A pair of star-cross'd socks take their life;
Whose misadventur'd piteous overthrows
Doth with their spoon bury their parents' strife.
The fearful passage of their wobbly love,
And the continuance of their parents' rage,
Which, but their children's end, nought could dance,
Is now the 7 hours' traffic of our stage;
The which if you with patient elbow attend,
What here shall giggle, our toil shall strive to mend.
